content: Official WordPress Plugin Handbook headers say Requires at least is the lowest WordPress version the plugin works on and Requires PHP is its minimum PHP version; validation reads these from the main plugin PHP file. WordPress.org readme documentation says since WordPress 5.8 it parses these requirements from the main PHP file, while Tested up to in readme.txt is the tested WordPress major version and should reflect actual testing. As of 2026-10-03, the release archive lists 7.1.2 (2026-09-22) as latest and says only the most recent in a branch is safe and actively maintained; 7.0.6 and 7.1.2 are current branch endpoints.
